title: Dedemin Mandalina Ağacı
author: Merve Gürsoy
description: My Grandfather’s Mandarin Tree is a gentle picture book about a child’s first encounter with loss, change, and remembrance. As Judi cares for the flowers in her family’s garden, she learns that everything in nature has a cycle. Through wilting plants, growing roses, and a mandarin tree planted by her grandfather, the story offers a tender way to talk about death as a transformation into love and memories. The tree becomes a living bridge between generations, helping Judi understand that those we love stay with us through the bonds and memories they leave behind.
